component.name: BRnotes
component.summary: Disposable sticky notes with screen-edge tabs

description.p: BRnotes provides temporary, colorful sticky notes for KDE Plasma. Move and resize each note, choose from seven colors, and tuck notes into screen-edge tabs.
Notes have a paper-like appearance and animated transitions. Hold the close button to crumple a note and toss it into a bin. Reduced motion is available.
Notes are never saved. Closing a note or logging out discards its text. The application requires X11 or XWayland, including in Plasma Wayland sessions.
